The '''Happy Blasters''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The group was named for their tendency to [[Blaster/Legends|blast]] anything that moved. Led by [[Salem Victory]], the Happy Blasters undertook a mission to [[Kriekaal]] in pursuit of an artifact rumored to be imbued with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
